name: FramePreviewPicker
job: Let shoppers preview a print or artwork in different frame styles and sizes on a wall, scaled against a sofa-height guide
visitor_action: click frame style, size and orientation (portrait or landscape) controls; the frame material crossfades and the print springs to its new size while the cast shadow stretches and settles
owner_settings: Sizes (label, width and height in cm)
mobile: chips and the orientation control stack under the preview, wall fills width
motion: frame style swaps with a quick crossfade; size and orientation animate with a spring, and the orientation thumb slides with the same spring curve (reduced-motion: instant swap)
provenance: original, built from a concept description
art_direction: Gallery wall: soft sage plaster wall, oak, black and brass frame options, gentle raking light shadow
notes: Prints taller than ~116 cm are display-clamped to the wall scene, so the silhouette understates true scale; render and craft gates were skipped this build (shot.sh disabled) 2026-11-24: polish pass 2026-11-23: scene quality + orientation (Guy review). Orientation uses each size's long and short side, so Landscape always shows the long side horizontal; chip labels stay as the owner wrote them.
